language: All field values are English except review_note_zh, which holds the reviewer's original Chinese evidence text.
workbook: core_review_2289.xlsx: 7 sheets (review_pool, notes, stage_statistics, coverage_check, frozen_recheck, item_review, scope_rulings)

fields.review_id: queue identifier used across the review workbook (Q + number)
fields.formula_id: identifier of the formula record in the frozen run
fields.review_cohort: signed_2026-11-15 = original signed queue records; queue_blank_backfill_2026-11-23 = blank queue rows reviewed on 2026-11-23; core_only_added_2026-11-23 = core-layer records absent from the original queue, reviewed on 2026-11-23
fields.review_round: review round label as recorded in the workbook
fields.priority: priority tag carried from the original queue
fields.already_in_gold: record already part of the Gold set at signing time
fields.review_confidence: item-level review confidence for the 477 records reviewed on 2026-11-23 (high/medium); null for the 1,812 records signed on 2026-11-15
fields.failure_stage: authoritative first failing stage: none / formula tree / candidate identification / region completeness / OCR / M-labels / target scope / M-labels pending / duplicate
fields.initial_failure_stage: first-pass judgment; for the 1,812 signed records this is the 2026-11-15 value, for the 477 it is the 2026-11-23 first-pass judgment
fields.item_review_status: consistent / changed for the 477 item-level records; null for the 1,812 signed records
fields.human_conclusion: reviewer's conclusion in the original schema, rendered in English
fields.human_core_eligibility: whether the current machine record can be used as a core record without repair
fields.dataset_included: false for the three records ruled out of dataset scope (Q0173 and Q0284 table constants, Q2510 figure annotation); they count as 'no error' but do not enter the dataset
fields.scope_ruling: scope ruling text for the three excluded records, otherwise null
fields.human_independent_formula: detected region judged an independent formula
fields.human_ocr_faithful: machine OCR judged faithful to the page
fields.human_tree_faithful_to_ocr: formula tree judged faithful to the OCR string
fields.human_tree_faithful_to_page: formula tree judged faithful to the page
fields.human_m_labels: human M01-M12 structural pattern label set
fields.human_machine_labels_correct: human judgment on the machine label set
fields.machine_tree_label_check: machine labels checked against the machine tree
fields.machine_label_difference: difference between machine labels and the checked labels
fields.review_note_zh: evidence and reasoning, reviewer's original Chinese text
fields.frozen_core_eligibility: core eligibility in the frozen run
fields.book_title: book title as recorded in the queue
fields.source_file: source PDF filename; the PDF is not distributed
fields.pdf_page: PDF page number as stored in the queue
fields.candidate_number: candidate sequence number on the page
fields.bbox_200dpi_px: detection box in 200 dpi pixel coordinates, x0,y0,x1,y1
fields.frozen_ocr_latex: frozen-run OCR text, repeated here for side-by-side comparison with the signing-time machine output
